story.title: Story 2: Event Capture and Turn Derivation

result.reviewScopeSummary: Initial verification of Story 2 against AC-2.1 through AC-2.8, TC-2.1 through TC-2.9, current capture source/tests, production capture paths, LHC duplicate-key behavior, and configured gates.

newFindings.title: No-id, no-position capture events still collide on fallback idempotency keys
newFindings.evidence: AC-2.1 requires every finalized PI message to be recorded and AC-2.6 requires duplicate safety without dropping distinct events. The local production hook type keeps both MessageEndEvent.entryId and MessageEndEvent.position optional in packages/pi-lhc/src/pi/types.ts:36-39. The hook path only supplies fallbackId from event.position when entryId is absent in packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:379-385, and runtime-change hooks do the same for optional position in packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:402-415. If position is absent, eventKey falls to fallbackId "no-stable-id" in packages/pi-lhc/src/capture/idempotency.ts:54-60. Focused checks failed: two no-entryId/no-position same-text user prompts produced the identical key `pi:s:fp:no-stable-id:0:user:user_prompt:2cda7449dd14dbba9a0c9de9`, and two identical model_select events without position produced the identical key `pi:s:fp:no-stable-id:0:system:runtime_note:fad453e343e63228f9ea2f15`. LHC skips duplicate idempotency keys in packages/lhc/src/domains/intake-stream/internal/pipeline.ts:210-216, so later distinct events on this production path can be skipped.

verified: AC-2.1 / TC-2.1: user/assistant/toolResult source-order capture and assistant thinking -> text -> tool_call fan-out are covered through the real hook -> converter -> LHC intake path in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/converter.test.ts:43-87.
AC-2.2 / TC-2.2: the worked example records exactly one LHC turn_end at agent_end and PI per-step turn_end hooks produce none in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/turn-derivation.test.ts:39-83.
AC-2.2 / TC-2.3: two runs with repeated turnIndex 0 order by converter source-event order in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/turn-derivation.test.ts:86-118.
AC-2.3 / TC-2.4: parallel out-of-order tool results correlate by toolCallId in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/parallel-and-errors.test.ts:39-77.
AC-2.4 / TC-2.5: tool result isError and error content are captured without drop in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/parallel-and-errors.test.ts:80-105.
AC-2.5 / TC-2.6: graceful interrupt partial content, aborted disposition runtime_note, and complete-but-aborted turn close are covered in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/abort.test.ts:29-65.

AC-2.6 / TC-2.7: stable-key re-delivery skips and normal resume without historical re-fire are covered for entryId/source-position-backed cases in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/parallel-and-errors.test.ts:145-191 and packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/reattach-idempotency.test.ts:138-168.

AC-2.7 / TC-2.8: malformed writable-thread input records a durable capture gap surfaced in health, unavailable store records health signal with no thrown hook exception, and unmappable hook input records a gap in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/converter.test.ts:140-276.
AC-2.8 / TC-2.9: model_select and thinking_level_select produce ordered runtime_note events with previous/new values in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/converter.test.ts:90-137.
unverified: AC-2.1 / AC-2.6 / TC-2.7: distinct no-entryId/no-position same-content message_end events are not safely recorded; focused evidence shows duplicate fallback idempotency keys.
AC-2.8 / TC-2.9: repeated identical runtime-selection events without position are not safely recorded; focused evidence shows duplicate fallback idempotency keys.

Required proof that PI always supplies entryId or position to the production hooks is absent from the story, tech design, research evidence read, and local types; the implemented absent-position path remains live.

gatesRun.command: pnpm --filter pi-lhc exec tsx -e 'mapMessage two same-text no-entryId/no-position user prompts must produce distinct keys'
pnpm --filter pi-lhc exec tsx -e 'mapModelSelect two identical no-position runtime changes must produce distinct keys'

productionPathFindings: packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts relies on optional event.position as the only fallback discriminator when entryId is absent; packages/pi-lhc/src/pi/types.ts does not require that field, and packages/pi-lhc/src/capture/idempotency.ts collapses the absent-position path to `no-stable-id`, causing duplicate-key skips in LHC intake.
additionalObservations: Configured story and epic gates pass: 14 test files / 68 tests passed in each gate run.
Prior unmappable-hook gap and multiple unsupported tool-result omission key issues are covered by current code/tests and were not reopened in this initial verification.
No material fake adapter, mock path, shim, or placeholder was found in the Story 2 capture production path; later-story fail-closed inference stubs remain outside this story's capture scope.
